goal: One visually compelling full-page desktop design mockup for fictional Japanese confectionery shop; ~3 sections, hero takes visual priority.
source: Second Root design-library v0.2; curated concepts, not copied screen layouts.

art_direction.theme: Contemporary Japanese editorial confectionery; modern calligraphy-like typography without clichéd shrine motifs.
art_direction.hero: Make the exact name 架空菓庵 the dominant visual anchor; asymmetric but aligned on a disciplined grid.
sections: Hero: logo-type, one short verified tagline; maximal impact
Concept: restrained verified description + small selected menu subset; generous rhythm
Information: accurate opening hours, closed days and address; clear and quietly beautiful
art_direction.motion: Not depicted; no need for invented animation.

techniques.name: typographic hero
techniques.use: Shop name is primary artwork, large distinctive Japanese type; allow emptiness to amplify it.

techniques.name: selective vertical type
techniques.use: One tiny Japanese accent may be set vertically.
techniques.avoid: Vertical addresses, hours, or long copy.

techniques.name: asymmetric precise grid
techniques.avoid: Random floating elements, repeated split-screen template.

techniques.name: three-part visual rhythm
techniques.use: Hero loud, concept gentle, information precise.
techniques.avoid: Same visual structure for every section.

hard_rules: Original composition; no close copying of any reference
No generated or real photos of food/products/shops
No invented claims, prices, awards, founder name, testimonials, business history, or logo
No publication; image is a design spec for later Claude implementation
Exact business facts must come from scripts/sales-design-worker/compare/shops/wagashi.json
Generated text is NOT source of truth; implement from facts JSON
